name: ironalarm-effect-refactor
north_star: Proper Effect-TS library with dependency injection, testable APIs, and composable patterns
goal: Transform ironalarm from Promise-wrapped Effect to proper Effect-TS patterns: Context/Service, Schedule for retry, Fiber concurrency, structured logging

error_design.principle: All failures are explicit in the error channel. No swallowed exceptions.

errors.message: No handler registered for task name
errors.when: schedule() or runNow() called with unregistered taskName
errors.user_action: Register handler via scheduler.register(name, handler) before scheduling

errors.message: Task operation conflicts with current state
errors.when: Pausing running task, resuming non-paused task, etc.

stories.title: Design and implement tagged errors
stories.description: Define all error types as tagged errors. All errors must be raiseable via yield* in Effect context.
acceptance_criteria: HandlerMissing, TaskNotFound, TaskConflict defined as Data.TaggedError
Each error has _tag, message, and relevant fields
Errors are raised via yield* new Error({...}) in Effect.gen
Tests verify error types and messages
stories.verification: bun run test (errors.test.ts passes), typecheck passes

stories.title: Add SchedulerService Context.Tag for dependency injection
stories.description: Add Context.Tag<SchedulerService> to enable testable services and DI
acceptance_criteria: SchedulerService Tag defined with checkpoint, completeTask, schedule methods
Context imported from effect
Tests can mock SchedulerService via Layer.succeed
Live implementation uses actual scheduler
stories.verification: bun run test (context.test.ts passes), typecheck passes

stories.title: Refactor TaskHandler to use SchedulerService instead of concrete ReliableScheduler
stories.description: Change TaskHandler signature to receive SchedulerService from Context
acceptance_criteria: TaskHandler type: (taskId: string, params: unknown) => Effect.Effect<void, never, SchedulerService>
Handlers no longer receive ReliableScheduler instance directly
Handler can access service via Effect.service(SchedulerService)
Tests mock handler and verify service access
stories.verification: bun run test (handler.test.ts passes), typecheck passes

stories.title: Convert public APIs from Promise<T> to Effect<T, E, R>
stories.description: Remove Effect.runPromise wrapping, return Effect types directly
acceptance_criteria: schedule() returns Effect.Effect<void, HandlerMissing, SchedulerService>
runNow() returns Effect.Effect<void, HandlerMissing, SchedulerService>
checkpoint() returns Effect.Effect<void, never, SchedulerService>
completeTask() returns Effect.Effect<void, never, SchedulerService>
getTask() returns Effect.Effect<Task | undefined, never, SchedulerService>
getTasks() returns Effect.Effect<Task[], never, SchedulerService>
Tests verify Effect types and error channels
stories.verification: bun run test (effect-api.test.ts passes), typecheck passes

stories.title: Replace manual retry logic with Schedule.exponential + Effect.retry
stories.description: Use Effect's Schedule module for composable retry policies
acceptance_criteria: Schedule imported from effect
retryCount/maxRetries removed from Task interface signature (kept for compatibility)
Task execution wrapped in Effect.retry(schedule)
Retry uses exponential backoff with jitter
Tests verify retry behavior (fail 2x, succeed on 3rd attempt)
stories.verification: bun run test (retry.test.ts passes), typecheck passes

stories.title: Replace Promise.all with Effect.forEach({ concurrency })
stories.description: Use Effect's Fiber concurrency instead of Promise.all
acceptance_criteria: Promise.all replaced with Effect.forEach
Concurrency limit parameter respected
Fibers interrupt properly on error
maxConcurrentTasks option still works
Tests verify concurrent execution and interrupt handling
stories.verification: bun run test (concurrency.test.ts passes), typecheck passes

stories.title: Replace console.error with Effect.log* for structured logging
stories.description: Use Effect's logging module for observability
acceptance_criteria: console.error calls replaced with Effect.logError
console.log calls replaced with Effect.log
Log levels appropriate (debug, info, error)
Logging still outputs to console via runtime
Tests verify log output structure
stories.verification: bun run test (logging.test.ts passes), typecheck passes

rules.error_handling: All failures must be in the error channel (E in Effect<A, E, R>). No try/catch that swallows errors.
rules.tests_first: Write tests BEFORE implementing. All tests must pass before moving to next story.
rules.git_checkpoints: Commit after each story with message: 'feat: [ID] - [Title]'
rules.verification: Every story requires: typecheck passes AND bun test passes
